title: 海滩渔货铺
theme: 原创小海獭在海滩渔货铺里捕捞、采集、补货和扩建
concept: 只用移动完成近岸捕鱼、潮池原地投建解锁、实体堆叠、有限货架补货、顾客结账和升级的竖屏海滩物流经营游戏
coreLoop: 移动到近岸渔网或已解锁潮池并靠近自动取货
鱼或海带以有类型可见堆叠显示在小海獭头顶
移动到对应冰盘或海带篮自动逐件补货；货架达到 8/8 后立即停止卸货并保留背篓余货
海边游客选货、等货、取货并前往收银台排队
玩家在收银区完成交易并让贝壳币实体化
把贝壳币直接投入未解锁的潮池，满 96 后同一位置切换为海带采集点
购买携带容量升级，并为下一阶段的虾笼预留站点

economy.sourceOfTruth: one generated economy configuration must drive simulation, HUD, save normalization and tests

carrier.capacityMode: total items across every product type

products.unlock: invest 96 shell coins directly at the locked tide-pool source; no separate construction station

shelfCapacity.deliveryRule: deliver only while the matching shelf stock is below 8; once it reaches 8, stop immediately without removing another carried item
shelfCapacity.overflowRule: never discard or convert overflow; unmatched or excess carried food remains visibly attached to the player
shelfCapacity.resumeRule: after a customer consumes one unit and opens a slot, proximity delivery may resume on a later simulation tick
shelfCapacity.progressRule: do not bank delivery progress while a matching shelf is full; reset the delivery timer so reopening one slot cannot cause an instant multi-item burst
shelfCapacity.persistenceRule: on load, defensively clamp legacy or invalid shelf stock to the inclusive range 0..8 before simulation resumes
shelfCapacity.feedbackRule: each shelf shows 库存 current/8 and appends 已满 at 8/8; the HUD also shows both current/8 values

requiredSystems: normalized keyboard and pointer/touch drag movement
typed multi-product carrying stack whose combined item count never exceeds the one displayed carrier capacity
automatic proximity harvest and compatible-shelf delivery with a hard per-product shelf capacity of 8
customer finite state machine with a separate first-spawn delay, faster sustained demand after kelp unlock, out-of-stock waiting and checkout queue
physical shell-token pile collected by proximity
locked tide-pool investment unlocking kelp in place with no standalone construction station
explicit two-tier capacity upgrade table 4 to 6 to 8 with visible player-attached full-state feedback and a clear max-level state
product-specific fish and kelp sale rewards
versioned throttled local save with legacy inventory normalization
local first-session balance telemetry with no backend dependency

playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.visibleWhen: carried item count equals current player capacity
playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.transition: one-shot local pulse only when entering full state
playerAttachedCapacityIndicator.placement: above the highest carried item when clear; if a cached HUD exclusion rectangle conflicts, choose the first scene-safe attached fallback from stack-right, stack-left, or player-side-below

originalityConstraints: Do not use Monkey Mart names, code, assets, UI, map layout, tuning or unlock order
Use only the generic spatial logistics mechanic and generic seafood categories
Keep all silhouettes, palette, beach layout, progression and numbers original
Use the original Chinese 满载 badge and dynamic avoidance behavior rather than copying competitor MAX lettering or styling
testRequirements: Retain exactly all seven window.__GAME_TEST__ controls
Write focused failing tests before each production behavior change and record the expected RED failure
Assert STATIONS has no standalone construction member and the old lower-right location never invests currency

Test partial investment, save recovery, completion at 96 invested coins, event positions at kelpSource, no further charge after unlock, and harvesting kelp at the same source on a later simulation tick
Test main scene and HUD copy contain only one spatial kelp unlock node and never render or mention 海带建设区 or 右下角建设区
RED first: test that fish plus kelp carried inventory never exceeds the one displayed capacity, including legacy save normalization and harvesting either product while mixed-loaded
RED first: test the explicit carrier tiers 4 to 6 for 40 coins and, only after kelp unlock, 6 to 8 for 88 coins; then reject further purchases and render 已满级 without a phantom next price
RED first: test fish orders create value-4 tokens and kelp orders create value-6 tokens from the shared economy configuration
RED first: test no automatic customer spawns before 22000 ms, pre-unlock spawning repeats every 5500 ms, and post-unlock spawning repeats every 4200 ms without resetting elapsed progress incorrectly
Test unlocking kelp increases total demand cadence rather than only splitting the former customer stream
Test fish and kelp stock compatibility, queue order, shell-token collection, upgrade and save recovery
RED first: with shelf stock 8 and matching carried food, advancing delivery time must leave shelf stock and carried items unchanged; record that the pre-change model incorrectly increments beyond 8
Test the 7-to-8 boundary with at least two matching carried items: exactly one item is delivered, the shelf stops at 8, and the remaining carried item stays with the player
Test both fish and kelp shelves independently enforce capacity 8 and never accept the other product type
Test delivery progress is not accumulated while full: after a customer consumes one unit, only one newly timed delivery can refill the single free slot
Test load validation clamps negative or above-capacity shelf values into 0..8 without losing unrelated save progress
Test the station counters render 库存 current/8, append 已满 only at 8/8, and the HUD exposes both shelf capacities without obscuring the playfield

Satisfy the WebLiteRuntimeAdapter machine contract by keeping localStorage in generated TypeScript source and declaring CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION = 4 or an equivalent accepted literal save-v4 marker; test a real refresh round trip from both save-v3 and save-v4
Test the 满载 marker at 0/4, 3/4, 4/4, unload, 4/5 and 5/5
Test the marker does not intersect cached HUD exclusion rectangles at the upper-left fish source in 360x800, 390x844 and 430x932 viewports

Test first-session telemetry records first move, pickup, stock, sale, cash collection, build investment, unlock and upgrade once, plus full-carrier time, empty-shelf time, completed orders and movement distance without any network dependency
Test that repeating automatic interactions never trigger a full-screen camera flash
Keep the playable beach and HUD legible inside CSS safe-area insets with no horizontal overflow
